config.deal: If you are buying 4 lizards I will include the rack they are in to keep them for an extra $100. These are made from big bells tubs that are almost 1m x 60cm in floor space with air vents added and a water bowl holder I designed that is fixed to the side to prevent the lizards filling it with bedding and knocking it over (although sometimes they still manage to do that). Heated with a 75w heat cable (thermostat not included). You can't get these tubs in WA and the racks cost me significantly more to build, so it is a very good deal!

Q1.description: Breeding group includes the 4 tub rack they are currently in, so a full set up for them to be kept. A complete breeding package. This group is made up by mostly individuals with very clear bellies, which is a higher indication of whitesided. All show very beautiful patterns. All individuals are from unrelated females. With the genetics in the group there is lots of possibilties to make multigene morphs.

Q5.description: Breeding group includes the 4 tub rack they are currently in, so a full set up for them to be kept. A complete breeding package. This group includes visual piedsided male, he is a gun and will easily mate 6 females in a season. You could produce visual Patchwork/Piedsided/Whitesided in combination with T+. All babies will be het for Piedsided (Patchwork/Whitesided). Females BZ11 and C have successfully been bred to this male and produced beautful babies that I have retained for my collection. You will get Whitesided and Piedsided from BZ11.

animals.description: This female is a big girl, she is pure local form. She has made some lovely babies passing on the granite like patterning distinct to this local. She can be a bit cage defensive, but once out handles very easily.

animals.notes: Piedsided

animals.description: This female is huge! She gave me a litter of 18 this last season, the babies were all very big on birth and incredibly healthy. A fantastic lizard to add to your collection as an outcross to bring in some healthy new genetics.
